note: Discovery only. Grid: 2 environments (Base, Ethereum) x 7 asset classes x 16 valid durations x 6 USD buckets x bound/unbound, plus 8 invalid-duration controls. 'Bound' means recordFeeAndRac was called right after the lock, at the creation-time price run. 'Unbound' means the first submission happens after the next price run. Local Hardhat deployment; the Ethereum cells use a locally posted Ethereum price, which the live Verifier does not have yet.

findings.description: Across the whole grid, every unbound valid lock is minted at the price of the run current at first submission, not the run at lock creation. Native ETH (price x2) mints double; ERC-20 TKN (price x0.5) mints half. Same on Base and Ethereum and at every valid duration. Bound cells mint at the creation price. Same root cause as AG-06.
findings.evidence: 244 cells DEVIATION:mint_at_later_price (Base native 76, Base erc20 46, Ethereum native 76, Ethereum erc20 46). Example: Base ETH 1h lock at $0.01 minted 0.26 VCLM where the creation-time price gives 0.13.
findings.damage_potential: Free option on price for every lock that is not submitted at once (see AG-06).

findings.description: A lock that is valid at creation (in band at the creation price, fee already paid to the Dev Fund) becomes unmintable if a price run moves its USD out of band before the first submission. The Verifier re-checks the band at the later price: a Handshake that rises above $0.02 is refused with VF-COM-003, and a standard lock that falls below $0.01 is refused with VF-COM-009. The fee is kept and no VCLM is issued. The spec says a lock keeps its creation price. Root cause is AG-06 (price bound at first submission); AG-16 is the lock-side band gate.
findings.evidence: 68 cells DEVIATION:valid_lock_not_minted outside the stablecoin classes: TKN price 2 to 1 drops $0.01 and $0.015 standard locks below $0.01 (60 cells, VF-COM-009); ETH price x2 pushes $0.015 and $0.02 Handshakes above $0.02 (4 cells, VF-COM-003); TKN Handshake cases (4 cells, VF-COM-003). All on Base and Ethereum alike. Fee equals the 5% floor and reached the Dev Fund in every one.
findings.damage_potential: User pays the fee and gets no VCLM for a valid lock. Limited to locks near the band edges and to the fee amount. Principal release at maturity was not tested by this rig.

findings.description: The USDC/USDT $0.95 rule is applied at the first Verifier submission, not at lock creation, in both directions. The spec says a stablecoin below $0.95 is unavailable for every new lock, and that an existing lock keeps its creation price. (a) Depeg after the lock: a USDT lock created at $1.00 and first submitted after a run at $0.94 is refused with VF-ORC-005; the fee is kept and no VCLM is issued while the price stays below $0.95. (b) Lock during a depeg: the lock contracts have no $0.95 check, so a USDC_X lock is accepted at $0.94 and the fee taken. The Verifier refuses it while the price is below $0.95, but the refusal leaves the lock unbound, so after a later run at $1.00 it mints at $1.00. This happens even when the record was attempted at creation. Only the app is meant to refuse the lock; a direct contract call skips that.
findings.evidence: Part (a): 156 cells DEVIATION:valid_lock_not_minted (stable_above_then_below, VF-ORC-005), Base and Ethereum. Part (b): 308 cells DEVIATION:minted_but_spec_refuses (stable_below_then_above, 154 of them bound, with record_err_A VF-ORC-005 and the record at B succeeding), plus 4 Handshake cells where the lock was accepted, the fee taken and the later band check refused it (DEVIATION:lock_accepted_fee_taken_no_mint). Example: USDC_X lock at $0.94 worth $0.01 minted 0.138 VCLM at the $1.00 run.
findings.damage_potential: (b) Buy a depegged USDC/USDT row, lock it, and mint at the recovered price: about 6% more VCLM per dollar at a $0.94 depeg, scaling with depeg depth. (a) Fee paid with no mint during a depeg.

pass_cases: Fee rule: all 1620 accepted locks took exactly the floored 5% fee and the Dev Fund received exactly the fee (fee_not_5pct_floor 0, devfund_delta_ne_fee 0).
Protocol token refused as a lock input on every cell (384 cells, VF-TOK-007).
Out-of-band USD refused at the lock (CVL: handshake usd 68, CVL: standard usd 300).
The 8 invalid-duration controls were refused (CVL: duration).
Bound native and ERC-20 cells mint at the creation price.

Observation only, not a finding: for a 2-decimal token, amounts whose 5% fee floors to 0 are refused (CVL: zero fee or principal, 316 cells). This sets the real minimum for low-decimal tokens above $0.01.
